Name: Yellow Dirt Removal
Author: delightfullymad
Description:
BACKUP YOUR MAPS FOLDER BEFORE INSTALLING

Don't like the yellow dirt on your farm or in the town? This mod will change it to grass. Works in All seasons.

Place the contents of Maps to:

GOG - [b]C:\GOG Games\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps[/b]

Steam - [b]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Maps[/b]

Found a bug or anything that needs fixing? submit a bug and I'll fix it ASAP!
